newsitem.title: RUSSIA: French president arrives for Yeltsin talks.
newsitem.headline: French president arrives for Yeltsin talks.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac arrived in Moscow on Sunday for talks with Boris Yeltsin -- the Russian leader's first meeting with a Western politician since his release from hospital.

Chirac flew into Moscow's Vnukovo-2 airport and was driven directly to a government residence to meet Yeltsin, who is recovering from pneumonia. The talks are expected to last over two hours and focus on NATO plans for eastward expansion.
Russia is virulently opposed to the NATO plan, which it says will threaten its security.
Foreign media, including French journalists, have been barred from the meeting. All television film will be taken and edited by Russian broadcast authorities for general release.
President Yeltsin has seemed pale and aged in footage taken since he was released from hospital on January 20. Opponents charge that he is too ill to govern. His own aides say he is recovering well.
